name: Fiscalía General de la Nación
body: A meta description on every page analyzed, Organization JSON-LD, preloaded HSTS, and a Permissions-Policy. But the home, Quiénes somos, and Misión y visión pages are all titled just "Fiscalía General de la Nación".
lesson: Lead each title with the page topic, then the institution, so results stand apart.
summary: www.fiscalia.gov.co scores 78 out of 100 (C). 1 check fails now, 24 are at risk, and 18 pass. Fix first: 1 internal link leads to an error.

fix.title: 1 internal link leads to an error
fix.fix: Fix or remove each link, or redirect the old address with a 301 to the closest live page.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 18 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: 1 title is shared by more than one page
fix.evidence: "Fiscalía General de la Nación" on /, /la-entidad/quienes-somos/, /la-entidad/quienes-somos/mision-y-vision/ and 14 more.
fix.fix: Write a title that names what is different about each page.

fix.title: 57 images have no width or height
fix.evidence: The layout jumps when they load, which hurts Cumulative Layout Shift.
fix.fix: Set width and height (or aspect-ratio) on images.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Google Analytics 4 appears in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

fix.title: 1 cookie is sent without Secure
fix.evidence: Without Secure: cookiesession1. Set on /, /la-entidad/quienes-somos/, /la-entidad/quienes-somos/mision-y-vision/ and 15 more.
fix.fix: Set Secure on every cookie, and HttpOnly plus SameSite=Lax on session cookies.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
Every page has a meta description
Structured data parses and carries the expected properties
Share cards have a title, description, image, and URL
